summary: Focused re-test of iteration-3 findings PLUS regression of the four enhancements. BOTH prior issues are now FIXED and all regressions still pass. (FIX1) Cross-route navigation from product pages scrolls correctly: /product/iphone-titan-pro -> nav-link-specs lands at scrollY=6488 (>4000, #specs in view) within ~3s; /product/audio-buds-pro -> nav-link-engineering lands at scrollY=1205 (within 500-3000 band, #features in view) within ~2s; /product/audio-buds-pro -> nav-link-store lands at scrollY=2089 with #showcase rect.top=39 (in view) within ~2.4s. URL changes to '/' in all 3 cases. (FIX2) Footer no longer covered: lenis.scrollTo(document.body.scrollHeight) -> final scrollY=6214, footer top=622 (<0.75*innerHeight=810 triggers the SceneCaption hide). Inner scene-caption-* element is NOT rendered (hidden=true), the 3D watch is off-frame (screenshot confirms clean footer), footer-link-warranty bounding box (y=814) is visible, elementFromPoint at its coords returns the <A data-testid='footer-link-warranty'> itself (no overlay interception), and clicking it succeeded without timeout. REGRESSIONS all pass: (a) scene captions track all four sections - targeted the vertical midpoint of #hero(188), #features(1200), #showcase(3639), #specs(5993); scene-caption-hero/-features/-showcase/-specs each became visible=True; (b) colourway picker on /product/mac-titan-pro-16: 4 swatches (space-black, silver, starlight, midnight) all flip 'selected-colorway' text correctly, canvas stays alive (webgl context valid), 0 console errors; (c) compare tray: added 2 via compare-toggle-*, compare-modal opens visible=True, compare-close-button closes it, compare-clear-button empties the tray (0 compare-remove-* remain); (d) recently-viewed-section visible after visiting watch-titan-ultra then ipad-titan-pro-13; showcase-recently-viewed visible on the landing storefront section; (e) rail-hot-deals-next scrolls rail scrollLeft 0 -> 888; (f) cart-count-badge increments 0 -> 1 after quick-add; (g) theme-toggle-button flips html data-theme/class 'light lenis' -> 'lenis dark'; (h) GLB models return 206/200 (iphone.glb, watch.glb, macbook.glb) with 0 console errors across the full flow.

critical_code_review_comments: Landing.tsx re-aim schedule (300/900/1800/2700ms) without ScrollTrigger.refresh() is working but is brittle - any future increase in first-paint latency can push the hero/features into view before the target, and the 'last retry wins' pattern re-aims to the final target each time. Consider waiting on a Scene-ready event (or ScrollTrigger refresh event) instead of fixed timeouts.

SceneCaption.tsx uses footer.getBoundingClientRect().top < innerHeight*0.75 as the hide trigger - clean and verified working. Edge case: on very tall mobile viewports the 0.75 threshold could hide the chip while plenty of showcase/specs content is still above the footer; currently gated by lg:block so OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - both prior findings fixed, all four enhancement regressions and all core regressions pass.

seed_data_creation: None - test clears localStorage keys applebase-compare and applebase-recently-viewed to isolate state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration-3 issues (cross-route scroll + footer coverage) are resolved. For cross-route nav tests use wait_until='domcontentloaded' (NOT networkidle - the preview URL never reaches networkidle due to streaming/HMR) and poll scrollY for up to 6s after the nav click; mounts take ~2-3s. For scene-caption regression, target the viewport-centre offset of each section (section_top + section_height/2 - innerHeight*0.45) via window.__lenis.scrollTo(y, {duration: 0.6}) + 2s wait - a flat 0/1600/3600/5200 schedule can miss shorter sections. Theme toggle testid is 'theme-toggle-button' (NOT 'theme-toggle'). GLB count observed: 3 distinct files served (iphone/watch/macbook .glb).
rca of the issue: Iter-3 FIX1 RCA (confirmed resolved): Landing's cross-route scroll was calling ScrollTrigger.refresh() before scrolling, which reset scroll to 0 and cancelled the lenis.scrollTo. Fix removed refresh() from the retry path and added a 4th retry window - now the router-state scroll re-aims at 300/900/1800/2700ms post-mount and lands within ~2-3s. Iter-3 FIX2 RCA (confirmed resolved): the pinned 3D watch and fixed scene caption were overlapping the footer. Fix added a footer-triggered GSAP timeline in useThreeScene (Act 3 ends at '#specs bottom 35%') to slide the watch out of frame, and SceneCaption now computes `hidden = footer.rect.top < innerHeight*0.75` in its rAF handler to hide the chip once the footer scrolls into view. Verified empirically: at scrollY=6214 the inner scene-caption-* node is absent, the watch is off-frame, and the warranty link is the top element at its coords.
